exclusion_reason: Cloud save sync is implemented: only the overlay diff (new or hash-changed save files) is transmitted, base files and overlay files that match the base are excluded, and cross-device conflict resolution is deterministic (higher logical clock wins, hash tie-break) and order-independent. The benchmark stays red because applying the merged overlay against a live cloud endpoint needs the absent hosting service.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the sync uploads exactly the overlay diff with the base-exclusion proof and resolves conflicts deterministically.
active_gate_evidence: test/policy.test.mjs asserts save sync transmits only the new/changed overlay files and excludes the base, and that conflict resolution yields an identical result hash regardless of device order with the higher-clock writer winning.
procedure: Sync the save fixture and capture the transmitted set.
Assert the base and hash-matching file are absent from the set.
Resolve a planted conflict on two device and compare results.
